writtenNeedsReboot: Written to the device. Changes take effect after a restart.
applyFailed: Could not apply (device unreachable or rejected?).
rebooting: Device is restarting — connection will be back in ~20–30 s.
rebootFailed: Could not send the restart command.
outOfRange: The hub refused “{field}”: the value is out of range — this section was not written.
invalidEdit: Edit not accepted — fix the field marked red
timeOwnPanel: the time zone is saved with “Save” on the Time panel
domainReadOnly: the hub doesn't accept writes to this section
domainRefused: the hub didn't answer or refused
rebootSaveBody: The hub reads these settings only at start: {list}. It will write them and restart — the connection is back in 20–30 seconds. Energy metering isn't interrupted: the modules keep counting and the hub credits the gap. Other edits apply at once with “Apply”, no restart.
appliedAfterReboot: The hub is back: everything written before the restart is in force.
notAppliedAfterReboot: The hub is back, but it didn't take: {list}. Check these settings and save them again.
